about: Where the OnlyKey protocol and crypto are still implemented OUTSIDE this library. The maintainers keep building inside their own apps; every commit that touches one of these paths is work this library may have to port (with vectors taken from their implementation) or a capability change it has to record. `node scripts/upstream-watch.js` lists what changed since `since`. After porting (or deciding nothing is needed), move `since` forward and say why in the commit.

watches.name: firmware-libraries
watches.why: The device side: wire formats, transit, gates (webcrypt policy), new commands. Changes here update capabilities() and the versions table, and are the ground truth for every client.

watches.name: firmware-sketch
watches.why: The sketch: version string, build flags, which features a release compiles in.

watches.name: app-classic
watches.why: 0c-coder's shipping desktop app (5.6.0/6.0.0): protocol mixed into one file - new fields and messages appear here first.

watches.name: app-rewrite-0c
watches.why: The rewrite's device layer as 0c-coder carries it; its tests beside each file are an oracle for this library.

watches.name: app-rewrite-upstream
watches.why: The rewrite as upstream (trustcrypto) is building it - the App's direction is undecided, so both lines are watched.

watches.name: python-onlykey
watches.why: The CLI: a second, independent implementation of the protocol and the age/X-Wing maths - parity is checked by the test kit.

watches.name: lib-agent
watches.why: onlykey-agent (SSH/GPG): derivation formats (derived v2) the library must agree with.

watches.name: web-app
watches.why: The web app's built-in library - ours now, and being moved onto this library (plan Path W); until then its changes are ported here.
